create_ClassLabel_with_num_classes: create a ClassLabel feature connector with a specified number of integer classes
create_ClassLabel_with_names: create a ClassLabel feature connector with a list of string names for each class
convert_string_to_int_with_str2int: convert a class label string name to its corresponding integer value using str2int
